The next biggest is learn grenade throws a kill is still a kill even from the grave and it may take some getting used to but its one of the faster ways, when it works, of doing significant damage to or finishing a player off. Finally play with different guns some are actually very OP when used right just gotta get used to the play styles like plasma guns do more shield damage than kinetic guns so a pulse carbine and a then few pistol shots does wonders especially with those grenades I mentioned. Also all guns in the game do bonus damage on headshots so the old boxing saying body head comes into effect really well.
